blocks.orig: Rivertrees Country Inn is an elegant lodge with cottages and rooms along a river and in thickets of tall trees, giving the feeling of a homestead with the luxury of a lodge. The inn is beautifully designed in the style of yonder, with red tiles, light walls, dark-wood furniture, lovely linens and romantic bathrooms boasting tubs. The lodge sits on a charming country estate, sprawling ten acres of fertile greenery that is a sanctuary for the birds and wildlife indigenous to the area. The restaurant concocts tasty meals with garden-fresh ingredients and locally-grown coffees, and a spa is available for some well-deserved pampering.
blocks.html: Rivertrees Country Inn is a stylish lodge whose cottages and rooms lie beside a river and among groves of tall trees, so it feels like a homestead with the comfort of a lodge. The inn has an attractive old-style design, with red tiles, pale walls, dark wooden furniture, fine linens and romantic bathrooms with tubs. It stands on a charming country estate covering ten acres of fertile greenery, a haven for the birds and wildlife native to the area. The restaurant prepares tasty dishes with fresh ingredients from the garden and locally grown coffees, and there is a spa for some well-earned pampering.
